svg.title: May 2024 backtest: modelled heat-health risk vs official alerts
svg.desc: Median-ward mortality risk index (MRI) per day, 1 May to 15 June 2024, with the range across 48 Ahmedabad wards, the IMD red-alert window of 20–24 May, and a day-by-day comparison with the Heat Action Plan level from observed airport maximum temperature.
svg.text: Model vs official alerts — Ahmedabad, May–June 2024
Mortality risk index (MRI), 48 wards. Line: median ward. Band: lowest to highest ward.
Daily level: top row = Heat Action Plan rule on observed airport Tmax; bottom row = model, median ward.
